meta.title: Honey ✕ Maple — Two Homes, One Circle
meta.description: Compare everyday distances and estimated travel minutes from our front doors in Toronto (walking and transit) vs Raleigh (driving). Names only — never addresses.

toronto.name: Toronto
toronto.note: The nearby errands are walks; the farther ones include transit, access on foot, and a little waiting.

raleigh.name: Raleigh
raleigh.note: Even “just down the road” starts with a car key — and the good coffee lives a highway away.

metric.title: The coffee gap
metric.flavor: The nearest espresso is a highway away.
metric.minutesFlavor: Up north it’s a stroll; down south it’s a commute.

metric.title: The essentials gap
metric.flavor: Same cart of stuff — down south it comes with a parking lot.
metric.widestFlavor: The big-box run still crosses most of Toronto.
metric.minutesFlavor: A walk or transit ride up north; a drive down south.

metric.title: A Toronto-only ring
metric.soloFlavor: Raleigh has nothing in this circle yet.
metric.widestFlavor: The volunteer post holds the whole map.

metric.title: The date-night gap
metric.flavor: Up north the night out is a stroll; down south it’s a road trip.
metric.widestFlavor: A closed chapter keeps the widest ring of all.
metric.minutesFlavor: The one errand where the stroll wins — dinner is closer on foot than by car.
